title: django-storages holds DB connections for the whole duration of the file upload, resulting in long claims on a connection for large files
author: cawilliams97
body_preview: We've been investigating some issues with DB timeouts on our service, and the core issue is that all the connections are already in use, the queue keeps growing, and it times out before a connection opens up for it.
